# dsh-iot-studio
English | 简体中文
IoT studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness: **one generic, brand-neutral tool layer** for the agent to d
iscover, inspect, and control smart-home devices. Not tied to any single vendor — a new IoT device i
s usable immediately once paired in its brand app, and a new brand attaches by registering one `IotB
randProvider`. Ships with **xiaomi / mijia** built-in.

> **Open-source attribution.** The built-in xiaomi provider's cloud protocol
> (login, RC4/SHA1 requ

est signing, device listing, MIoT spec lookup) is
> adapted for TypeScript from hass-xiaomi-miot
> b

y **al-one**, licensed under **Apache License 2.0** — the same license as
> this repository. See NOT

ICE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
> for the file-by-file provenance and changes. This plugin is an inde

pendent
> derivative work and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by
> Xiaomi Inc. or
the Home Assistant project.
## What it gives the agent
Five brand-neutral tools; every call takes an optional `brand` key:
| Tool | Purpose |

| `iot_list_devices` | All devices on the account: did, name, model urn, online, home/room |
| `iot_
get_spec` | Friendly MIoT spec of one device: services, properties (access/format/range/enum), actio

ns (in/out) |
| `iot_get_props` | Read specific properties, or a whole-device snapshot (≤ 60 readabl

e props) |
| `iot_set_prop` | Write one property: power, brightness, target temperature, mode… |
| `
iot_call_action` | Run one action with positional in-arguments |

Plus a bundled skill (`iot-studio`) that teaches the agent the safe loop:
list → spec → read → act →

verify, with explicit confirmation before touching
locks, cameras, power strips, heaters, and vacuu

rify, with explicit confirmation before touching
locks, cameras, power strips, heaters, and vacuums.

## New brands: one provider to register

A brand is one folder under `src/brands/<name>/` implementing `IotBrandProvider`
(list devices, get

spec, read/write properties, call actions) plus one
`register()` line in `src/brands/registry.ts`. T

ool signatures, config shape,
auth-cache layout, and the skill contract stay identical, so agent beh

avior
transfers unchanged. A second brand's cloud settings will get their own
`<brand>:` config bloc

hanged. A second brand's cloud settings will get their own
`<brand>:` config block beside `xiaomi:`.

## Limitations (v0.1)

- Built-in providers: xiaomi only so far; the seam is generic and more brands land on request.
- Cap

tcha / SMS / email verification during login is not interactive: the tool
returns an actionable mess

age asking you to sign in once at
account.xiaomi.com or in the Mi Home app.
- Legacy miio-only devic

es (model is not a `urn:miot-spec-v2:...`) are not
supported; MIoT-spec devices only.
- Cloud contro

l only; no LAN/local token path yet.
- Mainland China and overseas Xiaomi server sites are supported
via `serverCountry`.
